description: This file defines themes and appearance-related configurations for a chat UI component in a cross-platform Swift project, supporting both iOS and macOS. It includes color schemes, gradients, and appearance adjustments based on the operating system.

methods.name: resolvedAssistantBubbleColor
methods.description: Determines the assistant bubble color based on system appearance for macOS.

methods.name: resolvedOnboardingAssistantBubbleColor
methods.description: Determines the onboarding assistant bubble color based on system appearance for macOS.

methods.name: image
methods.description: Creates an Image instance from a platform-specific image, depending on whether the platform is macOS or iOS.
